name: Lying Lips
overview: Scripture firmly condemns lying lips, portraying dishonesty as an abomination to the Lord and contrasting it with the delight He takes in truthfulness. The commandments explicitly forbid bearing false witness and raising false reports, emphasizing the unrighteousness of deceitful speech. Proverbs highlights that while truth endures forever, lies are fleeting and expose the speaker to judgment, underscoring the righteousness found in honesty and the evil inherent in falsehood.
